comparison.objective: Candidate installs rack hardware; record samples a sealed handhole atmosphere before conditionally removing its cover bolts.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs structural latching and fastening; record routes a hose through a slot, maintains it for 60 s, interprets an alarm state, and conditionally unscrews bolts.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks rail engagement and screws; record fails on premature or alarm-state loosening and otherwise checks sample duration, bolt removal or preserved closure, hose withdrawal, clearance, and pull-test behavior.
comparison.reason: Conditional hazardous-atmosphere testing and stop-on-alarm sequencing are unrelated to rail installation despite later fastener use. Candidate screw and safety thresholds are missing.
